name: Software Testing and Verification
description: Introduces automated testing algorithms and verification fundamentals via model checking. Emphasis is on designing test algorithms rather than tool usage. Students learn to test complex systems, with coverage-based and unit testing review, followed by systematic test generation strategies. The final week explores impactful recent research and synergies between model checking and testing. Students develop a medium-scale software prototype and conduct systematic testing using course techniques, with prototypes exchanged among groups to simulate industry testing practices.
